name: ingestion/IngestedFile
purpose_statement: Deterministic summary of a single file ingested by the zero-UI Ingestion sidecar.

field_descriptions.file_id: Deterministic id derived from the file content hash.
field_descriptions.source_path: Source file path supplied to the sidecar.
field_descriptions.sha256: SHA-256 digest of the file bytes.
field_descriptions.line_count: Number of text lines in the UTF-8 previewable content.
field_descriptions.word_count: Whitespace-delimited word count in the UTF-8 previewable content.
field_descriptions.text_preview: First short text preview, safe for deterministic fixture validation.
